Once upon a time, there was a rich man who had a very special cane. 

Every day he went to the store to buy some special glue. He especially liked the cane.

Next, he bought the cane. He carried it to the store and put the cane into the car. He brought it home and it was very cozy.

Every day he checked around the house, put the tool in the car and watch. He hoped that the cane would get back in the car, just like nothing was going to be before.Once upon a time there was a big, wide river.
